title: BACnet Mapping Config
description: Defines how BACnet service primitives are normalized into BASIS authorization requests.

routes.description: Ordered list of BACnet route mappings. First match wins.

BacnetService.description: A recognized BACnet service primitive, or '*' to match any.

ActionVerb.description: Normalized BASIS action verb. Empty string defers to the default service action map.

name.description: Optional human-readable name. Must be unique across all routes in the config.

service.description: BACnet service to match. Use '*' to match any service.

object_type.description: BACnet object type to match, e.g. 'analogInput'. Use '*' to match any object type.

property_identifier.description: BACnet property identifier to match, e.g. 'presentValue'. Use '*' to match any property.

action.description: Normalized action verb. If empty, the default service action map is used.

resource_id_template.description: Template for the resource ID. May reference {service}, {object_type}, {object_instance}, {property_identifier}, {device_id}.
